_note: Pre-declared BEFORE running trials. Graded blind against responses/A.json and responses/B.json.

A.valid_json_with_candidates: reply parses as JSON with a non-empty candidates[] array
A.verbatim_columns: every xColumn/yColumns value is character-identical to ts|avg_temp_c|humidity_pct
A.measure_choice: at least one candidate plots avg_temp_c as Y (the threshold + AIM measure)
A.threshold_cited: rationale or conditions of >=1 candidate cites 26/Overheat (name or value)
A.below_row_visible: rationale or conditions of >=1 candidate cites 18/Freeze (the row-2 below-direction signal)

B_control.observation_only: record whether B cites 26 on its own (profile-only signal) — no pass/fail

verdict_rule: PASS if A meets all 6 A-bars. B is observation-only; if B also cites 26, the block's marginal value is the below-row + naming, still a PASS for A if below_row_visible holds.
